provenance.method: Current GOV.UK PIP eligibility and claim guidance checked on 2026-08-28. Listing is jurisdictional signposting only and makes no individual entitlement claim.

name: GOV.UK — Personal Independence Payment (England and Wales)
description: Official GOV.UK information about Personal Independence Payment (PIP), including eligibility and how to claim for the England and Wales route.
intended_use: Check the current PIP route when disability or a long-term health condition causes difficulty with everyday tasks or getting around.
audience_or_context: People using the PIP system in England or Wales; Scotland uses Adult Disability Payment and Northern Ireland has its own PIP route.
limitations: This listing does not determine eligibility or likely award level.
Scotland uses Adult Disability Payment instead; Northern Ireland has a separate PIP route.
Benefit rules and rates can change.
cost_or_access_notes: Official guidance is publicly accessible; applications may involve forms and an assessment depending on the case.
conflicts_of_interest: GOV.UK is the first-party government source for the England and Wales route; ND Oracle does not assess individual entitlement.
